name: Yonezawa (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Yonezawa city emblem in white: a stylised chrysanthemum-like flower of eight petals.
history: Municipal flag of Yonezawa, a city in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 September 1908.

features.role: Yonezawa city emblem — a stylised chrysanthemum-like flower of eight petals
